entities.name: Alphonsus Liguori Penney
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Archbishop Alphonsus Liguori Penney was a Canadian Catholic priest who was Archbishop of St. John's from 1979 to 1991. He was born in St. John's, Newfoundland.
